Message.Name: Trade Full Information Message
Message.Description: Trade full information message is sent each time a trade or a cancellation of a trade has occurred

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the Trade generation time

Field.Name: TradeIDNumber
Field.Description: Unique numeric and increasing Identifier of the trade, set by the trading engine

Field.Name: VenueOfExecution
Field.Description: Identification of the venue where the transaction was executed

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: PriceNotation
Field.Description: Indication as to whether the price is expressed in monetary value, in percentage or in yield

Field.Name: TransactionToBeCleared
Field.Description: Code to identify whether the transaction will be cleared

Field.Name: CumulativeQuantity
Field.Description: Cumulative number of securities traded on UTP since the start of the current trading session Note: Value accumulated within the individual segments

Field.Name: HighestPrice
Field.Description: Highest Price traded during the day(To be calculated with the PriceScaleCode)

Field.Name: LowestPrice
Field.Description: Lowest Price traded during the day(To be calculated with the PriceScaleCode)

Field.Name: VariationLastPrice
Field.Description: Percentage variation of Last Traded Price to last reference price (signed) (To be calculated with the VariationScaleCode)

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds

Field.Name: PriceCurrency
Field.Description: Currency in which the price is expressed as defined by ISO 4217 (applicable if the price is expressed as monetary value)

Field.Name: LastTradeIndicator
Field.Description: Last trade at same price indicator

Field.Name: TypeOfTrade
Field.Description: Trade related conditions

Field.Name: TradeOrigin
Field.Description: This field indicates the origin of the trade

Field.Name: TickDirection
Field.Description: Symbol of the variation of the price versus the previous (traded or reference) price

Field.Name: OpeningTradeIndicator
Field.Description: If the trade took place during the opening auction or during the core session

Field.Name: VariationScaleCode
Field.Description: To be combined with VariationLastPrice

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Applicable to all prices in the message except for the field "Price"

Field.Name: TradingDateTime
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction was executed

Field.Name: PublicationDateTime
Field.Description: Date and time when the transaction was published by a trading venue

Field.Name: InstrumentIdCodeType
Field.Description: Code type used to identify the financial instrument Always equal to 'ISIN'

Field.Name: InstrumentIdCode
Field.Description: ISIN code used to identify the financial instrument, as defined in ISO 6166

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Traded price of the transaction excluding, where applicable, commission and accrued interest

Field.Name: Quantity
Field.Description: Number of units of the financial instrument, or the number of derivative contracts in the transaction

Field.Name: NotionalAmount
Field.Description: Nominal amount or notional amount

Field.Name: NotionalCurrency
Field.Description: Currency in which the notional is denominated as defined by ISO 4217

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: For future use

Field.Name: TransactionIDCode
Field.Description: Alphanumerical code assigned by trading venue used in any subsequent reference to the specific trade

Field.Name: MMTMarketMechanism
Field.Description: Defines the market mechanism following MMT level 1

Field.Name: MMTTradingMode
Field.Description: Defines the trading Mode mechanism following MMT level 2 Possible values: - '1': Undefined Auction (not used) - 'O': Scheduled Opening Auction - 'K': Scheduled Closing Auction - 'I': Scheduled Intraday Auction (not used) - 'U': Unscheduled Auction - '2': Continuous Trading - '3': At Market Close Trading - '4': Out of Main Session Trading (not used) - '5': Trade Reporting (On Exchange) - '6': Trade Reporting (Off Exchange) - '7': Trade Reporting (Systematic Internaliser) (not used)

Field.Name: MMTAlgorithmicIndicator
Field.Description: Defines the algorithmic indicator following MMT level 3.9

Field.Name: MMTModificationIndicator
Field.Description: Defines the modification indicator following MMT level 3.4

Field.Name: MMTNegotiationIndicator
Field.Description: Defines the negotiation indicator or pre-trade transparency waiver following MMT level 3.2

Field.Name: MMTSpecialDividendIndicator
Field.Description: Defines the special dividend indicator following MMT level 3.6

Field.Name: MMTContributionToPrice
Field.Description: Defines the contribution to price or the price discovery process following MMT level 3.8

Field.Name: MMTBenchmarkIndicator
Field.Description: Defines the benchmark indicator or the reference price indicator following MMT level 3.5

Message.Name: Price Update Message
Message.Description: The Price update message contains a bid price or an ask price in case of alternative indicative price (AIP), or the modification of the last reference price on a given instrument

Field.Name: SymbolIndex
Field.Description: UTP-MD proprietary identification of the instrument

Field.Name: SourceTime
Field.Description: This field specifies the message generation time

Field.Name: SourceSeqNum
Field.Description: This field specifies the sequence number assigned by the source system to this message

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Last Price of the trading day (To be calculated with the ScaleCode)

Field.Name: HighestPrice
Field.Description: Highest Price traded during the day (To be calculated with the PriceScaleCode)

Field.Name: LowestPrice
Field.Description: Lowest Price traded during the day (To be calculated with the PriceScaleCode)

Field.Name: VariationLastPrice
Field.Description: Percentage variation of the price / last reference price (To be calculated with the VariationScaleCode) (signed)

Field.Name: SystemID
Field.Description: The ID of the originating Exchange/System of the message

Field.Name: SourceTimeMicroSecs
Field.Description: Number of micro seconds

Field.Name: TypeOfPrice
Field.Description: Market- Code identifying the type of price that is updated

Field.Name: Filler
Field.Description: For future use

Field.Name: PriceScaleCode
Field.Description: Applicable to all prices in the message

Field.Name: VariationScaleCode
Field.Description: Available for the price variation in the message
